extension.summary: Automatically track your Kodi watches on PunchPlay.tv
extension.description: Track movies and TV episodes you watch in Kodi, sync progress to PunchPlay.tv, import watched history, and rate titles after watching.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a PunchPlay.tv account and a running PunchPlay API backend.
extension.news: 1.5.2 - Fixed concurrent token-refresh 401 errors and watched toggles being suppressed after playback or resume syncs. Pull sync now reports and retries Kodi library write failures without one bad item blocking newer changes. Shutdown preserves queued and in-flight playback events for ordered offline replay.
